newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Hibernia oil platform positioned at field.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Hibernia oil platform positioned at field.

text.p: The 600,000 tonne Hibernia oil platform has been successfully positioned in the Hibernia field about 315 km east southeast of St. John's, Newfoundland, the company developing the field said on Friday.

It said the concrete skirts underneath the platform were now penetrating the seabed. The concrete base of the platform would be grouted to the seabed over the weekend, after which more than 400,000 tonnes of iron ore would be added to the Gravity Base Structure (GBS) to serve as solid ballast. The ballasting operation would take 30 days to complete, Hibernia Management and Development Co Ltd said in a statement.
Production is scheduled to begin December 15. The Hibernia field contained about 3.0 billion barrels of oil, of which 615 million barrels were estimated to be recoverable.

Partners in Hibernia are Petro-Canada's Petro-Canada Hibernia Partnership with 20 percent, Mobil Corp unit Mobil Oil Canada Ltd with 33.125 percent, Chevron Corp unit Chevron Canada Resources Ltd with 26.875 percent, Murphy Oil Corp 's Murphy Atlantic Offshore Oil Co Ltd with 6.5 percent, the government of Canada's Canada Hibernia Holding Corp with 8.5 percent and Norsk Hydro A/S with five percent.
